name: Darcy
source:
Role: Alchevisionist
Linbarrow's own little Hildegard. She cooks, she brews, she cares for all of the plants and animals... [Spoiler]I must admit I didn't expect any of that from her when we first met. Her manner of speaking is even flatter than Eustace's. Perhaps that is why they get along? Darcy is also by far the most honest about her complex relationship with Catherine. I really hope it wasn't her.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the in-game description]
